question: What happens after attaining the Lord?
premises: Great souls reaching the Lord do not return to rebirth.
Yogis attaining the Lord avoid birth-fear.
inference: Attainment of the Lord ends the cycle of rebirth and its fear.
uncertainties: Commentary prose is fused with verse tokens.
plain_english: Having attained me, great souls do not return to the impermanent abode of suffering; elsewhere return remains.
